set.body:
Exact witness: SupportAssessment successor 6a218927a3492e27d34915aed4bcbf269bb004e7. Support shares are bit-stable after sorted eligible-term summation, but fresh WOG HSMM inference differs between Scala Native and JVM/JS by one ULP in one transition-flow value and one posterior value, producing a distinct Native hsmm/v4 JSON SHA-256. This bead is separate from support honesty. Acceptance: build a minimal exact-stage reproduction; localize the first divergent operation without assuming the cause; distinguish platform arithmetic, algorithm order, serialization, and fixture effects; run the consequence through P, F, RecallSignature, codec bytes, and any identity/cache consumers; and make an explicit scientific contract decision between cross-platform bit identity and a named tolerance plus platform/receipt distinction. Courts must preserve exact hex witnesses, fail if the divergence is silently hidden, and forbid claiming one canonical byte identity when platform outputs differ. No production fix, tolerance, codec change, or widened scope is authorized until the localization evidence is reviewed.

promoted from discussion post post-01M1D1K66NR5X1RVJ3ZENNWSZC in topic coordination
set.title: Characterize and govern Native HSMM 1-ULP posterior and flow divergence
